title: Exemption
description: ATC exemption requests in SAP for the findings marked as Exemption in the remediation.
newBatch.title: New exemption batch
newBatch.description: The batch gathers the session items with Exemption status and links each one to the exact finding.
newBatch.prioritiesHint: Outside the checked priorities the item is only counted; with no known priority it stays out of the batch.
newBatch.includeObsHint: For old sessions where the exemption was saved as a "request exemption" remark.
newBatch.reportDescription: Check what got in and what was left out before moving on to discovery.
report.byOrigin: Linked by Finding ID: {{link}} · by matching with the extraction: {{cross}}.
report.withoutLinkHint: They stay out of the batch: without the exact finding the exemption cannot be requested.
report.probablyNoScopeHint: Finding with checksum -1 (e.g. syntax error) or ABAP Query: SAP tends not to accept an exemption for this finding only. The simulation confirms it.
batch.title: Exemption batch
batch.subtitle: {{environment}} · created on {{date}} · {{priorities}}
totals.title: Totals by status
busy.open: See the run that is blocking: {{kind}} (started by {{by}})
discovery.intro: Read only: checks whether SAP accepts exemption requests (ATC policy, reasons, validities, approvers and ADT service).
discovery.blockedTitle: Batch blocked by the exemption policy
discovery.blockedPolicy: This system's exemption policy is {{policy}}; ADT only accepts requests with A – any result. The fix belongs to the ATC administrator (transaction ATC, Setup, Configure ATC for the policy and Maintain Approvers for the approvers). MigATC does not change that configuration.
discovery.okText: Go on to the request parameters.
discovery.warnings: Warnings (they do not block; SAP decides on sending)
discovery.userExemptions: Exemptions already requested by the user
params.intro: Set who approves the request and how the justification is built. The consultant's default is reason FPOS (false positive: code already fixed that the check still flags).
params.approverHint: SAP user (or area, with suffix). It cannot be the environment's user ({{user}}): SAP requires four eyes.
params.approverSame: The approver cannot be the environment's own SAP user ({{user}}).
params.reasonHint: Comes from the ATC customizing in SAP.
params.prefixHint: Empty uses the default {{pattern}} (the reason code replaces MOTIVO). The justification is the prefix plus the item remark.
simulate.intro: Read only: reads each request's model in SAP and builds what would be sent. Nothing is written.
requests.selectPage: Select the simulated ones on the page
send.warning: Sending creates exemption requests for the approver in the system. It does not approve anything, but the requests created cannot be undone from here. Only what was simulated is sent.
send.production: Writing to SAP is blocked in production: sending is disabled.
send.nothing: There are no simulated requests to send. Simulate the batch first.
send.confirmText: {{count}} exemption request(s) will be created in environment {{environment}}, for approver {{approver}}.
send.confirmWarning: Each request is recorded in the system and waits for the approver's decision. Confirm only if the simulated batch is correct.
check.intro: Read only: queries SAP for the situation of each requested finding ("Exemption already requested" = request registered).
history.title: Batch history
history.empty: No run in this batch yet.
